stories.title: The Little Mermaid
stories.full_story: Far out in the ocean, where the water is as blue as the prettiest cornflower and as clear as crystal, it is very deep. There dwell the Sea King and his subjects. The Sea King's palace is made of coral. His old mother keeps house, proud of noble birth, with six sea-princesses, youngest the Little Mermaid, with beautiful voice. She is 15, may rise to surface. She sees prince on ship, storm sinks ship, she saves prince, falls in love. She visits Sea Witch who lives in creepy forest of polyps, gives her voice in exchange for human legs, each step feels like walking on knives. She drinks potion, tail becomes legs, but mute. Prince finds her, loves her as child but loves another princess he thinks saved him. Little Mermaid has chance to kill prince with knife given by sisters who traded hair to witch, to become mermaid again. She cannot, throws knife, throws herself into sea, becomes foam, but becomes daughter of air, earning soul after 300 years of good deeds. Moral on selfless love.
stories.moral: Andersen's tales teach compassion, resilience, and Christian hope
stories.source: H.C. Andersen - Public Domain, translation H.P. Paull 1872

stories.title: The Emperor's New Clothes
stories.full_story: An emperor loves fine clothes. Two swindlers claim to be weavers who can make cloth invisible to stupid or unfit. Emperor pays gold. Swindlers pretend weave on empty looms. Emperor sends old minister who sees nothing but pretends to see to not seem stupid. Emperor himself sees nothing but pretends. He parades naked in supposed clothes. Crowd pretends to admire until child shouts 'But he has nothing on!' Everyone laughs, emperor continues naked parade because cannot admit.
stories.moral: Andersen's tales teach compassion, resilience, and Christian hope

stories.title: The Little Match Girl
stories.full_story: It is bitter cold New Year's Eve, snowing. Little poor girl sells matches, no one buys, afraid to go home father will beat. She sits in alley, lights match to warm, sees vision of warm stove. Lights second, sees roast goose. Third, Christmas tree. Fourth, loving grandmother dead. She lights bundle to keep grandmother, grandmother takes her to heaven. Next morning, frozen body found with smile, matches burnt. Moral: neglect of poor.

stories.title: The Ugly Duckling
stories.full_story: A mother duck's eggs hatch, one egg larger, hatches last, ugly gray duckling mocked by all farmyard: ducks, hens, turkey cock. He runs away, meets wild ducks, hunters, old woman with cat and hen, all mock. Winter comes, he freezes in pond, farmer saves. Spring, he sees swans, ashamed to approach, looks in water, sees he is beautiful swan, not ugly duckling. Children cry 'new swan is most beautiful!' He was swan egg hatched in duck nest. Moral: beauty grows with hardship.

stories.title: The Snow Queen
stories.full_story: Devil made magic mirror that makes beautiful look ugly. Goblins break it, splinters fly into eyes and hearts making people cold. Kay and Gerda are friends. Splinter enters Kay's eye and heart, he becomes cold, mocks Gerda. Snow Queen, beautiful woman of ice and snow, kisses Kay (two kisses make forget Gerda, third would kill), takes him to palace in Lapland. Gerda searches: talks to river, old woman who combs hair with magic, crows, robber girl with knife, Lapland woman and Finland woman. Finmark, finds Kay in Snow Queen palace trying to spell 'Eternity' with ice pieces, but cannot. Gerda weeps, tears melt heart, removes splinter, Kay weeps removing eye splinter. They return home, now grown-ups, but children in heart.
stories.moral: Andersen's tales teach compassion, resilience, and Christian hope

stories.title: The Little Mermaid and more
stories.full_story: Far out in the ocean, where the water is as blue as the prettiest cornflower and as clear as crystal, it is very deep. There dwell the Sea King and his subjects. The Sea King's palace is made of coral. His old mother keeps house, proud of noble birth, with six sea-princesses, youngest the Little Mermaid, with beautiful voice. She is 15, may rise to surface. She sees prince on ship, storm sinks ship, she saves prince, falls in love. She visits Sea Witch who lives in creepy forest of polyps, gives her voice in exchange for human legs, each step feels like walking on knives. She drinks potion, tail becomes legs, but mute. Prince finds her, loves her as child but loves another princess he thinks saved him. Little Mermaid has chance to kill prince with knife given by sisters who traded hair to witch, to become mermaid again. She cannot, throws knife, throws herself into sea, becomes foam, but becomes daughter of air, earning soul after 300 years of good deeds. Moral on selfless love.

stories.title: The Little Mermaid full
stories.full_story: Far out in the ocean, where the water is as blue as the prettiest cornflower and as clear as crystal, it is very deep. There dwell the Sea King and his subjects. The Sea King's palace is made of coral. His old mother keeps house, proud of noble birth, with six sea-princesses, youngest the Little Mermaid, with beautiful voice. She is 15, may rise to surface. She sees prince on ship, storm sinks ship, she saves prince, falls in love. She visits Sea Witch who lives in creepy forest of polyps, gives her voice in exchange for human legs, each step feels like walking on knives. She drinks potion, tail becomes legs, but mute. Prince finds her, loves her as child but loves another princess he thinks saved him. Little Mermaid has chance to kill prince with knife given by sisters who traded hair to witch, to become mermaid again. She cannot, throws knife, throws herself into sea, becomes foam, but becomes daughter of air, earning soul after 300 years of good deeds. Moral on selfless love.
stories.moral: Andersen's tales teach compassion, resilience, and Christian hope

stories.title: The Snow Queen full
stories.full_story: Devil made magic mirror that makes beautiful look ugly. Goblins break it, splinters fly into eyes and hearts making people cold. Kay and Gerda are friends. Splinter enters Kay's eye and heart, he becomes cold, mocks Gerda. Snow Queen, beautiful woman of ice and snow, kisses Kay (two kisses make forget Gerda, third would kill), takes him to palace in Lapland. Gerda searches: talks to river, old woman who combs hair with magic, crows, robber girl with knife, Lapland woman and Finland woman. Finmark, finds Kay in Snow Queen palace trying to spell 'Eternity' with ice pieces, but cannot. Gerda weeps, tears melt heart, removes splinter, Kay weeps removing eye splinter. They return home, now grown-ups, but children in heart.

stories.full_story: Far out in the ocean, where the water is as blue as the prettiest cornflower and as clear as crystal, it is very deep. There dwell the Sea King and his subjects. The Sea King's palace is made of coral. His old mother keeps house, proud of noble birth, with six sea-princesses, youngest the Little Mermaid, with beautiful voice. She is 15, may rise to surface. She sees prince on ship, storm sinks ship, she saves prince, falls in love. She visits Sea Witch who lives in creepy forest of polyps, gives her voice in exchange for human legs, each step feels like walking on knives. She drinks potion, tail becomes legs, but mute. Prince finds her, loves her as child but loves another princess he thinks saved him. Little Mermaid has chance to kill prince with knife given by sisters who traded hair to witch, to become mermaid again. She cannot, throws knife, throws herself into sea, becomes foam, but becomes daughter of air, earning soul after 300 years of good deeds. Moral on selfless love.
stories.moral: Andersen's tales teach compassion, resilience, and Christian hope

stories.title: The Little Match Girl full story
stories.full_story: It is bitter cold New Year's Eve, snowing. Little poor girl sells matches, no one buys, afraid to go home father will beat. She sits in alley, lights match to warm, sees vision of warm stove. Lights second, sees roast goose. Third, Christmas tree. Fourth, loving grandmother dead. She lights bundle to keep grandmother, grandmother takes her to heaven. Next morning, frozen body found with smile, matches burnt. Moral: neglect of poor.
